title: Hostel Fee Due Reminder
content: All students are reminded that the hostel fee for June 2025 is due by 5th June 2025. Late payment will attract a fine of Rs.50 per day.

title: Water Supply Maintenance
content: Water supply will be interrupted on 8th June 2025 from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM due to pipeline maintenance. Please store water in advance.

title: Hostel Cultural Night
content: Cultural Night event is scheduled on 15th June 2025 at 6:00 PM in the hostel courtyard. All residents are invited.
